set.body:
Type: implementation task
Work key: CX01.2
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: Render the intent from CX01.1 as a Fix action on findings in the Assessment tab and the file inspector, and open the correction editor with the draft prepared.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Fix appears only for findings with an editing intent and the viewer's propose authority; others show "Open file".
2. The editor opens on the right document with the suggestion applied and visibly marked as a suggestion (diff against current content shown before preview); the reason field stays empty and required.
3. Table intents scroll to and highlight the flagged rows in the editor.
4. Back/Cancel returns to the finding, not to the top of the release page.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js
set.title: CX01.2: Offer Fix on findings and open a prepared draft
